ai_basics.generator_notes: The style checker passes all 70 pairs. The hard part was avoiding overlap: data/test_questions.json and the other topic files appeared while I was working. One question (033) crossed the 0.5 leak threshold against test-35. About 14 others repeated questions from the held-out test set (test-01, 04, 05, 07, 52, 59) or from other topics (voice bot vs tech_integration-021, buttons bot, API, translation vs agency, local models vs data_security, area/bedrooms vs agency_automation-034), so I replaced them with new ones: streaming output, quantization, reasoning models, ChatGPT vs GPT, sentiment, suspicious listings, refusals and so on. Now no question scores 0.3 or more against any test question, and the highest score against other batches is 0.24. Wherever FACTS.md says nothing (which models Alexander uses, local models, fine-tuning, technical stack, WhatsApp), the answer says the materials don't cover it and points to the разбор or Telegram.
